preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 1 and 10^5.
Each element of the array a is between 0 and its index.
The elements of the array a are non-decreasing.

postconditions.description: The array b has the same length as the array a.
Each element of the array b is between 0 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: for all i (1 <= i <= n): MEX({b_1, b_2, ..., b_i}) == a_i
postconditions.description: For each index i, the MEX of the first i elements of b is equal to the corresponding element of a.

postconditions.expression: if no such array b exists: output == '-1'
postconditions.description: If no valid array b can be constructed, the output is '-1'.
